name: dai-cgroup-probe-hostns
command: exec > /out/cgroup-probe-hostns.txt 2>&1; echo '== mount =='; mount | grep cgroup; echo; echo '== mountinfo =='; grep cgroup /proc/self/mountinfo | head -2; echo; echo '== /proc/self/cgroup =='; cat /proc/self/cgroup; echo; echo '== mkdir test =='; (mkdir /sys/fs/cgroup/dai-hns && echo MKDIR_OK) || echo MKDIR_FAIL; rmdir /sys/fs/cgroup/dai-hns 2>/dev/null; echo done
